title: payment.link_cancelled v1
description: Emitted by alebrije-mod-payments-go when a payment link moves from an open status to 'cancelled' — PaymentsService.UpdatePaymentLink (internal/service/payments.go) via publishLinkCancelled, which covers every cancel path: the PATCH /links/{id} soft-cancel, the internal S2S cancel used by agentic, and link_expiry_worker (an expired or orphaned link is cancelled, never left as a separate 'expired' status). Re-cancelling an already-cancelled link emits nothing. Published post-persist, best-effort, direct XADD (RedisEventPublisher.PublishPaymentLinkCancelled) exactly like payment.link_generated — the cancel is a plain UpdateFields with no transaction to ride — so a failed publish is logged at Error level with the link id. Stream default 'payment.link_cancelled' (config StreamPaymentLinkCancelled, env EVENTBUS_STREAM_PAYMENT_LINK_CANCELLED). Canonical envelope under a single 'payload' field, fields nested in `data`. First consumer: alebrije-mod-crm-go TimelineConsumer (C11: the 'fin' mark of a payment episode whose 'inicio' was payment.link_generated with the same link_id).

link_id.description: The cancelled payments.payment_links row — the same link_id payment.link_generated carried.

tenant_id.description: Owning tenant, redundant with the envelope-level tenant_id.

contact_phone.description: The link's contact phone as stored on the row (the payer's WhatsApp line); the consumer's admission key.

currency.description: ISO currency code of the link.

appointment_id.description: Present when the link was a deposit for an agenda appointment.

reference_type.description: Polymorphic reference kind (e.g. 'appointment', 'catalog_payment_offer') when the link was charging a specific entity.

reference_id.description: Id of the referenced entity, paired with reference_type.

occurred_at.description: UTC time the event was built, RFC3339 with nanoseconds.
